# Home Ground Butchery

Home Ground Butchery trades under Home Ground Investments, a Zimbabwean agricultural enterprise headquartered in Chivhu.

## Location

Al Majid Mall, A4, Chivhu, Zimbabwe, next to Chicken Inn.

## Products and supply

The business supplies farm fresh frozen chicken, turkey, pork, and graded beef. Home Ground Butchery serves walk in retail customers and commercial buyers including retailers, butcheries, and supermarkets. Distribution supports customers from Masvingo to Harare.
